# Fonts for the Clarity prototype

Original variable TrueType fonts downloaded from the official [Google Fonts repository](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl) on 2026-10-03. Each original SIL Open Font License is included beside its font file. Fonts are served locally with the prototype.

- [Inter](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter): `inter.ttf`, original `Inter[opsz,wght].ttf`.
- [Manrope](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope): `manrope.ttf`, original `Manrope[wght].ttf`.
- [Golos Text](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/golostext): `golostext.ttf`, original `GolosText[wght].ttf`.
- [Nunito Sans](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunitosans): `nunitosans.ttf`, original `NunitoSans[YTLC,opsz,wdth,wght].ttf`.
